---
title: Employee marketplace settings
description: Set the Git repository and token that the FDE marketplace and role template builder use.
translation:
  source: en
  status: complete
  sourceVersion: "2026-11-20"
---

A system administrator opens **Admin console → Employee marketplace** and configures the shared marketplace repository URL and Git token.

Initialize the builder from this page before the [Role template builder](/build/builder/) can open a session. This page does not edit a Plugin. Edit the Agent Package in the builder. Find plugins you can convert in the [standard employee marketplace](/build/market/).

The token is a credential. Do not paste it into an employee instruction, a skill, or a meeting transcript.
